description_en: Redirects to a business travel feature page
name: AddressGet

parameters.help_en: The employee ID. The employee must be registered in the business travel system before you pass this parameter. Otherwise, the call fails
parameters.help_zh: 员工 ID。传入之前需要完成在商旅的维护，否则会导致调用失败
parameters.name: user_id

parameters.help_en:
The itinerary ID.
When the redirect page is the business travel booking page (`action_type = 1`), you can optionally specify this parameter to quickly redirect to the booking page of the category associated with the itinerary.
The itinerary ID must have been submitted to the Alibaba Business Travel system through the Create a business trip approval (https://openapi.alibtrip.com/doc/toDocDetail?docId=4929938) operation
parameters.help_zh:
行程单号。
当跳转页面为商旅预定页面时 `action_type = 1` 时，可选择填入，以实现快速跳转至该行程单对应类目的预订页面。
传入的行程单号需要已经通过新增出差审批单 (https://openapi.alibtrip.com/doc/toDocDetail?docId=4929938)接口传入阿里商旅系统
parameters.name: itinerary_id

parameters.help_en: The business type. This parameter is required when the redirect page is the booking page (`action_type = 1`) or the order view page (`action_type = 2`)
parameters.help_zh: 业务类型。当跳转页面为预定页面`action_type = 1`或订单查看页面`action_type = 2`时，此参数必填
parameters.name: type

parameters.help_en: The contact phone number, typically used for car service scenarios
parameters.help_zh: 联系电话，通常用于处理用车业务
parameters.name: phone

parameters.help_en: The redirect page type. For illustrations of each page, refer to How to implement SSO redirection - Appendix (https://openapi.alibtrip.com/doc/toDocDetail?docId=4746411)
parameters.help_zh: 跳转页面类型，各页面图示请参见：如何实现单点跳转-附录 (https://openapi.alibtrip.com/doc/toDocDetail?docId=4746411)
parameters.name: action_type

parameters.help_en:
The sub-enterprise ID. When specified, the page redirects to the business page of the sub-enterprise.
View permissions: Only enterprise administrators have view permissions.
Path to obtain: Enterprise management console > Parent-child account management > Account management > Sub-account management > Company ID
parameters.help_zh:
子企业 ID，填入后可跳转至子企业相关业务页面。
查看权限：仅企业管理员有查看权限。
获取路径：企业管理后台 > 主子账户管理 > 账户管理 > 子账户管理 > 公司 ID
parameters.name: sub_corp_id

parameters.help_en: The car service scenario
parameters.help_zh: 用车场景
parameters.name: car_scenes_code

parameters.help_en: The redirect URL after Taobao account binding
parameters.help_zh: 淘宝账号绑定后跳转地址
parameters.name: taobao_callback_url

parameters.help_en: The departure city name
parameters.help_zh: 出发城市名
parameters.name: dep_city_name

parameters.help_en: The three-letter code of the departure city
parameters.help_zh: 出发城市三字码
parameters.name: dep_city_code

parameters.help_en: The arrival city name
parameters.help_zh: 到达城市名
parameters.name: arr_city_name

parameters.help_en: The three-letter code of the arrival city
parameters.help_zh: 到达城市三字码
parameters.name: arr_city_code

parameters.help_en: The departure date
parameters.help_zh: 出发日期
parameters.name: dep_date

parameters.help_en: The order ID. This parameter is required when the redirect page type is the specified order details page on either platform (`action_type = 11 or 12`)
parameters.help_zh: 订单编号。当跳转页面类型为双端指定订单详情页`action_type = 11 或 12`时，此参数必填
parameters.name: order_id

parameters.help_en:
The enterprise access token.
This is a required header parameter for HTTP calls. For information about how to obtain it, refer to Enterprise access token (https://openapi.alibtrip.com/doc/toDocDetail?docId=3769985).
You can use `corp_token=value` in the URL as an alternative
parameters.help_zh:
企业访问凭证。
是 HTTP 调用方式的 header 必填参数之一，获取方式请参见：企业访问凭证 (https://openapi.alibtrip.com/doc/toDocDetail?docId=3769985)。
可以在链接中使用 `corp_token=value` 替代
parameters.name: x_acs_btrip_so_corp_token

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to use the proxy booking mode.
The proxy booking page is accessible only when this parameter is set to 1
parameters.help_zh:
是否为代订模式。
仅填入 1 时，才可进入代订页面
parameters.name: use_booking_proxy

parameters.help_en: The ID of the actual traveler (the person being booked for)
parameters.help_zh: 实际出行人（被代订人）ID
parameters.name: traveler_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to skip the booking intermediate page.
When set to 2, the booking intermediate page is skipped. In this case, the itinerary_id parameter is required. If left empty or set to a value other than 2, the intermediate page is not skipped.
This parameter is available when the redirect page is the H5 booking page (`action_type = 1`) and the category is flight (`type = 1`) or train (`type = 2`)
parameters.help_zh:
是否跳过预定中间页。
填入 2 时,可跳过预定中间页，跳过预订中间页时 itinerary_id 参数必传。为空或填入非2的数值不跳过预定中间页。
当跳转页面为H5预定页面`action_type = 1`，且类目为机票`type = 1`或火车`type = 2`时可用
parameters.name: middle_page

parameters.help_en: The third-party application ID
parameters.help_zh: 第三方申请单ID
parameters.name: thirdpart_apply_id

parameters.help_en:
Session parameters. The format must be a JSON string where both keys and values are strings.
Example: "{\"returnURL\":\"https://open.alibtrip.com/\"}"
parameters.help_zh:
会话参数，格式要求key和value都是String的json字符串。
数据示例："{\"returnURL\":\"https://open.alibtrip.com/\"}"
parameters.name: session_parameters

requestId.description_en: The unique identifier of the request

success.description_en: Indicates whether the call is successful. Use this parameter to determine the result of the call
success.description_zh: 是否成功，请使用本参数判断本次调用成功与否

traceId.description_en: The global trace identifier of the request, typically used for troubleshooting
traceId.description_zh: 跟踪请求全局的标识符，通常用于问题排查定位
